topic: Promo: a pipeline diagram that builds itself, one topic line in, one finished animated video out, what the buyer gets and supplies
title: ONE LINE IN
ONE VIDEO OUT

script.text: One animated video means writing, recording, drawing, mixing and exporting. Every single time.
What if it all ran as one connected chain?
Type one topic line. It slides in from the left.
First, Claude writes the script, the shot list, the cuts and the sound plan.
Next, the voice is recorded from that script.
Then every frame is drawn in code and rendered.
The audio is mixed and mastered, and the diagram is complete.
A finished video comes out on the right.
Every stage you just watched is a real step in the system.
You get the engine, the cast, the sets, the scripts and the guides.
You supply your own keys for the voice and the writing.
No keys are included. One line in, one video out.
